title: Tamsin and the Postcard
author: Emrys Villalobos
blurb: Quentin Yarrow, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
